drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 52-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.42, creatinine 1.97-1.98, hemoglobin 12.5, platelets 304-308, sodium 140, wbc 8.4-8.6; vitals dbp 71-76, heart_rate 84-89, map 92-95, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 131-135, spo2 97-99, temp 36.8-37
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Acute kidney injury ruled out.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.96-2, hemoglobin 12.6-12.7, platelets 303-307, sodium 139-140, wbc 9.1; vitals dbp 72-76, heart_rate 84-89, map 92-96, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 130-137, spo2 97-99, temp 36.9-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 52-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
